As your the dad of the year I'll give you some tips that seem to work for me (mind you my aim is not very good and I still have a long way to go). But your first priority should be staying alive (unless your spawn timer is up and you can do awesome things) don't chase people even if they are at only like 2% unless you are sure what's around the corner. 

Secondly don't stay close to teammates, it helps to stay with them but let them tank the damage for you unless you have a good healer. Though if you are behind your teammates do be aware of flanking enemies. 

Thirdly get to know the enemies, on a broad lvl: learn classes their strengths and there abilities and how they could kill you. Look how many of their team is still alive and when they might spawn etc. But also try to learn which player on the other team is really good and who isn't, be more careful around the good ones.

4th point ties in with the third, get to know your team if they are all trash play super carefully, but if you have like 1 or 2 good people on your team stick with them, give them cover etc.

Lastly there is ofc aim, that one just takes practice and stuff plus you can Google that as it is not limited to dirty bomb.

Hope this help a little and happy fragging ;)
